verdicts.why: The selected test asserts the A08-1 withdrawal boundary: pointers outside or revoked from the session set receive the same not-found answer as an unknown pointer, remain unchanged, while an in-set pointer can be withdrawn. It does not assert A08-2 because it never checks that any pointer's owner_service equals the declared owner for its artifact type.
